| description = Dozekar is cursed to be resurrected only to be slain repeatedly by mortals training in the Halls of Testing. He has endured countless painful deaths and is forever denied rest. According to dragon law, dragons do not kill one another, which makes his fate an especially cruel form of eternal punishment. It is whispered that Dozekar's crime was his mating with a dragon of a different element, resulting in the birth of [[Kerafyrm]].

Dozekar drops Tears required for the [[Dozekar Tear Quests]]

Casts: [[Silver Breath]], [[Thunder Blast]]. Casts 400 damage AoE with 1 slot dispell.
